# Fallback

Don't spend a dollar of reasoning on a cent-sized problem.

Small pay-per-call recovery utilities for autonomous agents.

Catalog: https://fallback.factrail.online/catalog.json
MCP endpoint: https://fallback.factrail.online/mcp (active Streamable HTTP)
Agent skill: https://fallback.factrail.online/skill.md
HTTP execution: active
x402 payments: test mode

## Tools

### source_route
Find likely authoritative or machine-readable sources when you know what information you need but not where to retrieve it. Provide a goal and optional publisher domain or start URL; it returns ranked candidate routes and bounded evidence. Use it before blind searching. Do not use it when you already have the correct source or only need reasoning over supplied context.
Status: available
Price: $0.02 USD per call (x402 active)
HTTP: https://fallback.factrail.online/v1/tools/source_route
MCP: source_route
Category: source-discovery
Latency target: 12000 ms
Input schema: {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"goal":{"type":"string","minLength":3,"maxLength":500},"domain":{"type":"string","maxLength":253,"format":"hostname","pattern":"^(?=.{1,253}\\.?$)[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[-0-9a-zA-Z]{0,61}[0-9a-zA-Z])?)*\\.?$"},"start_url":{"type":"string","maxLength":2048},"preferred_formats":{"maxItems":7,"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["json","csv","xml","rss","api","bulk_download","html"]}},"require_official":{"default":false,"type":"boolean"},"max_candidates":{"default":5,"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":10}},"required":["goal"],"additionalProperties":false}

### stop_search
Determine whether a bounded search has gathered enough negative evidence to reasonably stop. Planned and unavailable.
Status: planned
Price: $0.02 USD per call (x402 inactive)
HTTP: https://fallback.factrail.online/v1/tools/stop_search
MCP: not callable (planned: stop_search)
Category: search-quality
Latency target: 1000 ms
Input schema: {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false}
Output schema: {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"status":{"type":"string"}},"required":["status"],"additionalProperties":{}}
Example: {}

### error_route
Diagnose a failed API, HTTP, MCP, or tool request and return a structured, bounded next action. Use it after a request fails instead of repeatedly retrying or spending a large reasoning loop diagnosing common errors. Provide a status, response, or error text; it does not execute requests or verify undocumented fixes.
Status: available
Price: $0.002 USD per call (x402 active)
HTTP: https://fallback.factrail.online/v1/tools/error_route
MCP: error_route
Category: recovery
Latency target: 50 ms
Input schema: {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"goal":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":500},"request":{"type":"object","properties":{"method":{"type":"string","maxLength":16},"url":{"type":"string","maxLength":2048},"headers":{"type":"object","propertyNames":{"type":"string","maxLength":128},"additionalProperties":{"type":"string","maxLength":2048}},"body":{}},"additionalProperties":false},"response":{"type":"object","properties":{"status":{"type":"integer","minimum":100,"maximum":599},"headers":{"type":"object","propertyNames":{"type":"string","maxLength":128},"additionalProperties":{"type":"string","maxLength":2048}},"body":{"type":"string","maxLength":8192}},"additionalProperties":false},"error":{"type":"string","maxLength":2048},"attempt":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100}},"additionalProperties":false}
